क्ष

KṢA {#(kza)#}. This letter means (1) kṣatriya (2) field (3) narasiṁha (the lion-man incarnation of viṣṇu) (4) hari (viṣṇu) (5) Protector of temples and gate keeper. (6) Lightning (7) Destruction (8) A demon.

क्षमा

KṢAMĀ . Wife of prajāpati pulaha. three sons kardama, urvarīyān and sahiṣṇu were born to pulaha of his wife kṣamā. (viṣṇu purāṇa, aṁśa 1, Stanza 10).

क्षमक

KṢAMAKA . A King of the puru dynasty. (agni purāṇa, Chapter 278).

क्षत्रदेव

KṢATRADEVA . The son of śikhaṇḍī. He was a famous archer. bhagadatta wounded the right hand of kṣatradeva in the bhārata-battle. He fought with lakṣmaṇa and droṇa. lakṣmaṇa killed him. (M. B. Udyoga Parva, Chapters 57 and 171; bhīṣma Parva, Chapter 95; droṇa parva, Chapters 14, 21 and 23; karṇa Parva, Chapter 6).

क्षत्रधर्मन्

KṢATRADHARMAN . A son of dhṛṣṭadyumna. The teacher droṇa killed him. (M.B. droṇa parva, Chapter 125, Stanza 66).

क्षत्रञ्जय

KṢATRAÑJAYA . A son of dhṛṣṭadyumna. droṇa killed him. (M. B. droṇa parva, Chapter 10, Stanza 53).

क्षत्रवर्मन्

KṢATRAVARMAN . A son of dhṛṣṭadyumna. He fought with jayadratha in the battle of bhārata. droṇa killed him. (M.B. droṇa parva, Chapter 186).

क्षत्ता

KṢATTĀ . II. See under the word varṇa.
